description: Demonstrates the role+metadata refinement AshwinUgale raised on Discussion #45 (proposed, not yet finalized): muteval's real per-mutant 'survived' outcome isn't one thing -- a survivor is either a genuine coverage gap or an inert/equivalent mutant muteval excludes from its effective mutation score, so a consumer reconstructing that effective score from group.role alone would get muteval's raw score instead. This fixture is the inert/equivalent-mutant branch: role stays the same coarse 'survived' verdict as the real-gap case (both mutants really did survive the suite unkilled), but metadata.output_changed: false (reusing muteval's own MutantOutcome field name from runner.py) marks this member as one an effective-score rollup should exclude. See spec/conformance/fixtures/group_role_metadata_real_gap_valid.json for the paired real-coverage-gap case -- the two fixtures together show both branches validate cleanly with zero schema changes and no growth in role's vocabulary.
